milestone: My goal is to improve the gross margin and profitability of our products by increasing the minimum batch size to 48 jars for economy of scale. During a 5hr day, we expect to make at least 96 jars (2x48). This increase lowers the Cost to Produce 1 jar by spreading labor (our largest cost) across more jars.
metrics: 48 jars minimum batch size, 96 jars/5hr day, 29.5% YTD revenue growth over 2025
